title: Screen-time plan
subject: Arabic
unit: Summer 1: Dates and days of the week; my electronic games
source: Seeded from arabic/y5 lesson 17 (Pupil PDF worksheet: screen-time plan)
intro: Lesson 17: My electronic devices and games; using them wisely. To understand Arabic words for devices and games and how to talk about using them wisely

questions.q: Say: I play a game on the computer for one hour.
questions.a: أَلْعَبُ لُعْبَةً عَلَى الحَاسُوبِ سَاعَةً وَاحِدَةً
questions.model: Teacher builds it: أَلْعَبُ (I play) + لُعْبَةً (a game) + عَلَى الحَاسُوبِ (on the computer) + سَاعَةً وَاحِدَةً (for one hour).

questions.q: Screen-time plan on the pupil PDF: three Arabic sentences about devices you use, when and for how long; then one rule in English for using them wisely. Start: أَلْعَبُ ...
questions.a: Three correct sentences with a device, a time word and a duration; one wise rule
questions.model: Teacher writes: أَسْتَعْمِلُ الحَاسُوبَ بَعْدَ المَدْرَسَةِ سَاعَةً وَاحِدَةً.

questions.a: For example: أَلْعَبُ قَلِيلًا لِأَنَّ الوَقْتَ مُهِمٌّ

questions.q: say 'I do not play during salah time': لَا أَلْعَبُ وَقْتَ الصَّلَاةِ.
Back to our ponder: wasted or good?
questions.a: It depends: used wisely and in moderation, after duties
